summary: VersaBank filed a 6-K announcing a special shareholder meeting to approve a proposed reorganization into a standard U.S. bank holding structure via a newly formed Delaware corporation, Versa Bancorp. The reorganization, which requires shareholder approval and regulatory nods from the Finance Minister in Canada and the U.S. Federal Reserve, aims to enhance capital access, index eligibility, and reduce costs. The S-4 registration statement is pending SEC effectiveness. No financial terms, premium, or deal value were disclosed. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and regulatory clearances; structural mechanics involve a top-tier holding company exchange.
